news.title: Father of boy rescued from pounding California surf says he is beyond grateful to teen lifeguard
news.summary: The father of a 10-year-old rescued from pounding surf off the California coast in a dramatic scene captured on video says he is beyond grateful to the teenage lifeguard who saved his son
